trust_decision.summary: Whether the production Appium HTTP server mounts built-in test pages (guinea-pig templates that render query/body/header values unescaped into HTML and an inline JS string), debug crash routes and the test static dir; decided unconditionally in configureServer at the pinned commit, moved by the fix to an opt-in env gate (APPIUM_ENABLE_LEGACY_TEST_PAGES) in server(). The fix does not escape anything.

landing_point.why: Summary names /test/guinea-pig* routes and reflected XSS; guineaPigTemplate is the handler that copies throwError/comments/user-agent into the template params.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API server() exported from @appium/base-driver (packages/base-driver/lib/index.js:18), used by `appium server` CLI via packages/appium/lib/bootstrap/main-helpers.ts:209
HTTP GET of any file under base-driver/static (e.g. /test/guinea-pig2.html, /favicon.ico)
HTTP ALL /test/guinea-pig* (sink handler; moved unchanged to test-pages/handlers.ts)
internal helper compileLodashTemplate (moved unchanged to test-pages/template.ts)
public export STATIC_DIR (re-pointed to test-fixtures dir, deprecated)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All behavioural changes are inside packages/base-driver/lib/express/server.ts (server() and configureServer); other changes are file moves. configureServer is not exported from the package barrel (packages/base-driver/lib/index.js:18).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Crash routes ({basePath}/produce_error, /crash) and express.static of test fixtures carry no reflected input, so a solver fixing 'XSS' would argue they are unrelated to the report and leave them mounted; likewise driver CI needs the pages, so a solver may escape output instead of un-mounting.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Driver CI relies on the guinea-pig pages, static fixtures (jquery, iframes, frameset) and the STATIC_DIR export; the pages must still render (including comment POST echo, user-agent, server time, cookies) when explicitly opted in, so deleting the routes/files outright or dropping the STATIC_DIR export breaks legitimate use.

O6_input_shapes: query string throwError (rendered into inline JS string literal) — packages/base-driver/lib/express/static.ts:37, packages/base-driver/static/test/guinea-pig.html:11-12
req.params.throwError / delay fallback (no route params defined at pinned commit) — packages/base-driver/lib/express/static.ts:36-37
POST body comments, urlencoded or JSON (body parsers at packages/base-driver/lib/express/server.ts:203,208) — packages/base-driver/lib/express/static.ts:44-45

O7_producer.where: Template params are built in the handler itself (packages/base-driver/lib/express/static.ts:38-46); templates are static files read at request time (packages/base-driver/lib/express/static.ts:63-66).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: welcome handler taking `message` from the query string instead of a constant, rendered into welcome.html <h1>
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: welcome.html already has a <%= message %> slot (packages/base-driver/static/test/welcome.html:8) and every other test page reads params from req.query; a maintainer could plausibly parametrize it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second implementation: a driver-CI helper in @appium/driver-test-support that mounts the guinea-pig templates on its own express server outside server()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix's own deprecation note tells driver CI to run a local test HTTP server with copied fixtures; a helper doing that in the test-support package is exactly what a maintainer would add, and an env gate in base-driver would not cover it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a value placed into an inline <script> string context (as throwError already is), where HTML-escaping alone is insufficient
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already the pattern in the shipped template; adds how-type room if the task is framed as output encoding rather than gating.
